LESSON: INTRODUCTION TO DRAWING

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Communication in Pre-Technical Studies
Topic 2.1: Introduction to Drawing

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Introduction to Drawing. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How are drawings used in technical communication?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain the importance of drawing as a means of communication
2. used in drawing • use audio-visual aids to study the application of symbols and abbreviations in drawing

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. explain the importance of drawing as a means of communication
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the importance of drawing as a means of communication. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. used in drawing • use audio-visual aids to study the application of symbols and abbreviations in drawing
   In simple words: practise until you can used in drawing • use audio-visual aids to study the application of symbols and abbreviations in drawing. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Introduction to Drawing using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Introduction to Drawing in the examples.
2. Explain Introduction to Drawing to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Introduction to Drawing.
4. Show that you can: explain the importance of drawing as a means of communication

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Introduction to Drawing using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Introduction to Drawing important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Discuss the importance of drawing as a means of communication,
2. Practice printing numbers and letters of the alphabet,
3. Draw various types of lines (thick and thin continuous, dashed and chain)
4. Communication and Collaboration: the learner acquires speaking, listening and teamwork skills when brainstorming on the meaning of the terms ‘technical drawing’ and ‘artistic drawing’.
5. Digital Literacy: learner develops the skill of interacting with technology when using online resources to search for information on artistic and technical drawing. Values:

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. explain the importance of drawing as a means of communication
2. used in drawing • use audio-visual aids to study the application of symbols and abbreviations in drawing

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
